steps.note: Aged cheese is ground up, as drying loses some of the aroma of a young one.
The cheese is melted with water and emulsifying salts into a slurry.
The slurry, concentrated to 35-45 % total solids, is homogenised before drying.
It is spray-dried, or in some cases foam-mat dried, to a powder.

links.name: Korean J. Food Sci. Anim. Resour. 38(5): 866 (review of cheese powders; outline of steps only)

sources.text: Aged cheese, a slurry of 35-45 % solids, homogenisation and spray or foam-mat drying are from Wikipedia; the melting with water and emulsifying salts is from the topic list of the review, whose full text was not readable.
